title: fix: qualify stdlib imports and replace alias with comptime
body:
## Summary
Fixes Mojo 0.26 deprecation warnings across `src/`:

- `from sys import argv` → `from std.sys import argv` (`main.mojo`)
- `from collections import Dict` → `from std.collections import Dict` (`registry.mojo`, `resolver.mojo`, `manifest.mojo`)
- `from os import getenv` → `from std.os import getenv` (`fs.mojo`)
- `alias INDEX_BASE` → `comptime INDEX_BASE` (`registry.mojo`)

## Test plan
- [ ] All test suites pass locally ✅ (toml, manifest, semver, validate, lockfile, flags, json, url, installer, update, remove, tcp — 10 suites)
- [ ] CI passes
